verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a production AI-agent tool that captures traces, surfaces recurring mistakes and compares outcomes against holdout groups, so alerting is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions threshold alerts on error rates, cost spikes or eval-score drops. It also shows no notification delivery to Slack, PagerDuty or email.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email
